title: 第17章 分数和秘辛第18章 天人演武图
content_zh:
“好饿。”
钱深摸了摸肚子，对眼前这些画展中的一幅幅画作毫无兴趣，只想找个地方大吃一顿。
毕竟是刚刚完成炼体补课再赶过来的，饥肠辘辘的他只觉自己能吃掉一头牛。
“我去找找有没有什么好吃的。”
和同来的同学们打过招呼，钱深便在展会里找了起来。
与他一同来到画展的学生们对此也是见怪不怪。
日日勤学仙道，苦炼**，他们所需要的营养，所进食的份量自然也远超常人。
像钱深这种24小时日夜苦修的学霸，那每日进食就更多了，一天只吃个五顿都会被家庭老师担心是不是胃口不好。
就在这时，钱深的目光陡然一亮，双眼已经紧紧盯上了自助餐的餐桌。
只见他快步走上前去，抓起一盘大虾便几口吞下，但吃了一会却皱起了眉头“这吃的这么没营养？”
钱深作为嵩阳高中一年级的学霸，一直以来的年级第二，除了自身的天赋和努力之外，最重要的当然还是家里有钱。
而为了提升修炼的效果，特别是炼体之效用，他往日里吃的食物中都富含种种仙道要素。
对他这种唯分数论者来说，好吃不好吃都是次要的，能够提升他修炼的效率才是最重要的。
画展自助餐提供的这些海鲜他平日里自然也吃得起，但他对这种专门花钱满足口腹之欲的事情并没有兴趣，反而觉得这是浪费了自己的时间和胃口。
什么海鲜、什么大餐……不能提升成绩？那不就是垃圾。
于是钱深一边打量餐桌上的其他菜色，一边开口唤来侍者，想要问问有没有别的可用作食补的食物。
“能吃的都在这里了，要什么自己拿吧。”
听着侍者有些冷冰冰的声音，钱深忍不住皱起眉头，结果抬起头来便看到了一张熟悉的脸。
钱深看着看了看对方身上的侍者服装，意外道“你在这里工作？”
“嗯。”白真真面无表情道“还有什么事吗？”

钱深却是皱了皱眉说道“你很缺钱吗？”
“那赶紧和学生会签约吧，不然继续把时间浪费在这种没有意义的工作上，只会拖累你的仙道之路。”
“到时候我就算超越了你，也没什么意思了。”
钱深的语气之中满是感叹，毕竟一直以来他都将白真真这位同年级唯一能在总分上超越自己的少女视为自己的对手。
在他的感觉中，白真真应该也是这么想的才对。
接下来的高中三年，整个年级甚至是整个学校，都将是他们两大天才人物争锋相对，却又惺惺相惜的战场。
两人应该会在一次次的竞争中突破极限，最终在三年后一同考入顶尖名校。
但面对钱深的感叹，白真真只是淡淡道“你在教我做事？”
没等钱深回答，白真真已经接着说道“你一个总分600出头的家伙，要教650的我做事？”
面对白真真**裸的成绩歧视，钱深作为一个唯分数论的坚定支持者，气势瞬间矮了下来，那50分的差距就好像是一座山峰一样向他砸来。
你分高，你说的有理。
这一刻在钱深的眼中，白真真的头顶上就像是有着闪闪发光的三个数字650，并散发出强大的压迫感，压得他一句反驳的话也说不出来。
content_en:
"So hungry."
Qian Shen rubbed his stomach. He was not interested in any of the paintings in the exhibition in front of him. He just wanted to find a place to have a big meal.
After all, he had just finished his physical training class and rushed here. He was so hungry that he felt that he could eat a cow.
"I'm going to look for anything good to eat."
After greeting the classmates who came with him, Qian Shen started looking for them in the exhibition.
The students who came to the exhibition with him were not surprised by this.
Studying the Immortal Way diligently and practicing ** every day, the nutrients they need and the amount of food they eat are naturally far beyond ordinary people.
A top student like Qian Shen, who studies hard day and night, eats more every day. If he only eats five meals a day, his tutor will worry about his poor appetite.
At this moment, Qian Shen's eyes suddenly lit up, and his eyes were fixed on the buffet table.
I saw him walking forward quickly, grabbing a plate of prawns and swallowing them in several bites. However, after eating for a while, he frowned and asked, "Is this food so nutritious?"
As the top student in the first grade of Songyang High School, Qian Shen has always been ranked second in grade. In addition to his own talent and hard work, the most important thing is of course his family's money.
In order to improve the effect of cultivation, especially the effectiveness of body training, the food he usually eats is rich in various immortal elements.
For a score-only person like him, whether it tastes good or not is secondary. What matters most is that it can improve the efficiency of his cultivation.
He could naturally afford to eat the seafood provided at the art exhibition buffet on weekdays, but he was not interested in spending money to satisfy his appetite. Instead, he felt that it was a waste of his time and appetite.
What kind of seafood, what kind of feast... can't improve your performance? That's just rubbish.
So Qian Shen looked at the other dishes on the table and called the waiter to ask if there was any other food that could be used as a supplement.
"Everything you can eat is here, take what you want."
Listening to the waiter's somewhat cold voice, Qian Shen couldn't help frowning, but when he raised his head, he saw a familiar face.
Qian Shen looked at the waiter's clothes on the other person's body and said unexpectedly, "You work here?"
"Yeah." Bai Zhenzhen said expressionlessly, "Is there anything else?"
Qian Shen frowned and said, "Are you short of money?"
"Then hurry up and sign a contract with the student union, otherwise you will continue to waste time on this kind of meaningless work, which will only hinder your path to immortality."
"Even if I surpass you then, it won't be interesting anymore."
Qian Shen's tone was full of sighs. After all, he had always regarded Bai Zhenzhen, the only girl in the same grade who could surpass him in total points, as his opponent.
In his feeling, Bai Zhenzhen should think so too.
In the next three years of high school, the entire grade and even the entire school will be a battlefield where these two geniuses compete with each other, but also cherish each other.
The two should break through the limits in competition again and again, and finally be admitted to a top prestigious school together in three years.
But facing Qian Shen's sigh, Bai Zhenzhen just said lightly, "Are you teaching me how to do things?"
Before Qian Shen could answer, Bai Zhenzhen continued, "You, a guy with a total score of over 600, want to teach me, who has a score of 650, how to do things?"
Faced with Bai Zhenzhen's naked performance discrimination, Qian Shen, as a staunch supporter of the score-only theory, instantly lost his momentum. The 50-point gap was like a mountain peak hitting him.
Your score is high and what you say makes sense.
At this moment, in Qian Shen's eyes, Bai Zhenzhen's head looked like there were three shining numbers 650, exuding a strong sense of oppression, which made him unable to say a word in rebuttal.
